neighbours.label: Spelling unit: the word-completing piece of 'mol|asses' and 'Malth|us' (also 'Malth|ace', weaker on 'mol|us|co'); not ' us' or 'asses' elsewhere
fire: Grandma's gingerbread calls for a full cup of dark molasses.
The lecture compared the ideas of Malthus with those of later demographers.
Rum is distilled from fermented molasses in most Caribbean islands.
Critics of Malthus argued that farming would keep pace with population.
Brush the ribs with a glaze of mustard and molasses before grilling.
In his famous essay, Malthus predicted recurring famine.
The feed mill mixes molasses into the grain to make it sweeter for cattle.
Darwin said that reading Malthus gave him the idea of a struggle for existence.
quiet: Grandma's gingerbread calls for a full cup of dark honey.
The lecture compared the ideas of Keynes with those of later demographers.
Rum is distilled from fermented cane juice in most Caribbean islands.
Critics of Marcus argued that farming would keep pace with population.
Brush the ribs with a glaze of mustard and maple syrup before grilling.
In his famous essay, Columbus predicted a short voyage.
The feed mill mixes wet grasses into the grain to make it softer for cattle.
Darwin said that reading the letter from us gave him the idea of a new voyage.

notes: Card: 'asses' after 'mol', 'us' after 'Malth'; a weaker tail on ' for' after 'matter/problem'. Probes: molasses 0.97, Malthus 0.88, molluscs 0.11, 'a matter for' 0.27, honey / Ricardo 0.00-0.01. Near misses swap in another sweetener or economist and include other '-us' / '-asses' words.
